q: Complete with the Past Simple or Past Continuous: It ______ (snow) when I ______ (leave) home this morning.
qa: أكمل بالماضي البسيط أو المستمر: كانت الدنيا تثلج عندما غادرت المنزل هذا الصباح.
h: Full sentence: It was snowing when I left home this morning.

q: Complete: It was a sunny afternoon and people ______ (sit) on the grass in the park. Then suddenly it ______ (start) to rain.
qa: أكمل: كان بعد ظهر مشمس والناس يجلسون على العشب في الحديقة. ثم فجأة بدأ المطر.
h: Full sentence: … people were sitting on the grass … suddenly it started to rain.

q: Complete: A: I tried to explain my problem to her. B: ______ (she / listen)?
qa: أكمل: أ: حاولت أن أشرح لها مشكلتي. ب: هل كانت تستمع؟
h: Full sentence: B: Was she listening?

q: Complete: My brother ______ (talk) on the phone when I arrived, but when he ______ (see) me, he ______ (finish) the call. Perhaps he thought that I ______ (listen) to his conversation.
qa: أكمل: كان أخي يتحدث على الهاتف عندما وصلت، لكن عندما رآني أنهى المكالمة. ربما اعتقد أنني أستمع إلى حديثه.
a: was talking; saw; finished; was listening
h: Full sentence: My brother was talking … when he saw me, he finished the call … I was listening …

q: Complete: I nearly had an accident today. A car ______ (come) towards me, but I moved quickly out of the way and fortunately nothing ______ (happen).
qa: أكمل: كدت أن أتعرض لحادث اليوم. كانت سيارة تأتي نحوي، لكنني تحركت بسرعة ولحسن الحظ لم يحدث شيء.
h: Full sentence: A car was coming towards me … nothing happened.

q: Complete: A: Which hotel ______ (you / stay) in when you lost your passport?
qa: أكمل: في أي فندق كنت تقيم عندما فقدت جواز سفرك؟
h: Full sentence: Which hotel were you staying in when you lost your passport?

q: Complete: B: I don't remember. I ______ (visit) many places during my European tour and I ______ (stay) in many different hotels.
qa: أكمل: لا أتذكر. زرت أماكن كثيرة خلال جولتي الأوروبية وأقمت في فنادق مختلفة كثيرة.
h: Full sentence: I visited many places … and I stayed in many different hotels.

q: Complete: I ______ (move) to Hastings in 1999. I ______ (live) there when I met them.
qa: أكمل: انتقلت إلى Hastings عام 1999. كنت أعيش هناك عندما قابلتهم.
h: Full sentence: I moved to Hastings in 1999. I was living there when I met them.

q: Complete: ______ (many people / wait) for the 9:15 bus last night?
qa: أكمل: هل كان كثير من الناس ينتظرون حافلة التاسعة والربع ليلة أمس؟
h: Full sentence: Were many people waiting for the 9:15 bus last night?

q: Complete: I ______ (dance) with my girlfriend when the disc jockey played our favourite song.
qa: أكمل: كنت أرقص مع صديقتي عندما شغّل منسق الأغاني أغنيتنا المفضلة.
h: Full sentence: I was dancing with my girlfriend when the disc jockey played our favourite song.

q: Complete: I ______ (study) grammar when I ______ (fall) asleep.
qa: أكمل: كنت أدرس القواعد عندما غفوت.
h: Full sentence: I was studying grammar when I fell asleep.

q: Complete: The scientists ______ (work) in their laboratory when they ______ (discover) the new drug.
qa: أكمل: كان العلماء يعملون في مختبرهم عندما اكتشفوا الدواء الجديد.
h: Full sentence: The scientists were working … when they discovered the new drug.

q: Complete: We ______ (climb) the wall when the gardener ______ (see) us.
qa: أكمل: كنا نتسلق الجدار عندما رآنا البستاني.
h: Full sentence: We were climbing the wall when the gardener saw us.

q: Complete: Vicky ______ (have) a beautiful dream when the alarm clock ______ (ring).
qa: أكمل: كانت Vicky تحلم حلماً جميلاً عندما رنّ المنبه.
h: Full sentence: Vicky was having a beautiful dream when the alarm clock rang.

q: Complete: As he ______ (run) for the bus he ______ (collide) with a street lamp.
qa: أكمل: بينما كان يجري للحاق بالحافلة اصطدم بعمود إنارة.
h: Full sentence: As he was running for the bus he collided with a street lamp.

q: Complete: When he ______ (carry) a suitcase, he ______ (drop) it on his foot.
qa: أكمل: عندما كان يحمل حقيبة، أسقطها على قدمه.
h: Full sentence: When he was carrying a suitcase, he dropped it on his foot.

q: Complete: ______ (you / do) your homework on the bus while you ______ (come) to school?
qa: أكمل: هل كنت تحل واجبك في الحافلة بينما كنت تأتي إلى المدرسة؟
h: Full sentence: Were you doing your homework on the bus while you were coming to school?

q: Complete: The students ______ (read) the article when the last class ______ (finish).
qa: أكمل: كان الطلاب يقرؤون المقال عندما انتهت الحصة الأخيرة.
h: Full sentence: The students were reading the article when the last class finished.

q: Complete: When I ______ (arrive) at the cinema, my friends ______ (wait) for me.
qa: أكمل: عندما وصلت إلى السينما، كان أصدقائي ينتظرونني.
h: Full sentence: When I arrived at the cinema, my friends were waiting for me.

q: Complete: ______ (you / listen) to the teacher when she ______ (explain) this exercise?
qa: أكمل: هل كنت تستمع للمعلمة عندما كانت تشرح هذا التمرين؟
h: Full sentence: Were you listening to the teacher when she was explaining this exercise?

q: Complete: Susan ______ (play) the piano while Mary ______ (sing).
qa: أكمل: كانت Susan تعزف على البيانو بينما كانت Mary تغني.
h: Full sentence: Susan was playing the piano while Mary was singing.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: She ______ (just go out).
qa: ضع الفعل في المضارع التام: لقد خرجت للتو.
h: Full sentence: She has just gone out.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: This is the nicest restaurant I ______ (see).
qa: هذا أفضل مطعم رأيته.
h: Full sentence: This is the nicest restaurant I have seen.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: Three people ______ the company this week. (leave)
qa: ثلاثة أشخاص غادروا الشركة هذا الأسبوع.
h: Full sentence: Three people have left the company this week.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: I ______ three letters already. (write)
qa: لقد كتبت ثلاث رسائل بالفعل.
h: Full sentence: I have written three letters already.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: We ______ two holidays this year. (have)
qa: لقد قضينا عطلتين هذا العام.
h: Full sentence: We have had two holidays this year.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: There ______ a revolution in San Serife. (be)
qa: لقد حدثت ثورة في سان سيريف.
h: Full sentence: There has been a revolution in San Serife.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: I ______ that film. (see)
qa: لقد شاهدت ذلك الفيلم.
h: Full sentence: I have seen that film.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: Someone ______ your front gate! (knock down)
qa: لقد أطاح شخص ما ببوابتك الأمامية!
h: Full sentence: Someone has knocked down your front gate!

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: It's the first time I ______ here. (be)
qa: هذه هي المرة الأولى التي أكون فيها هنا.
h: Full sentence: It's the first time I have been here.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: ______ Indonesian food? (you ever eat)
qa: هل سبق أن تناولت الطعام الإندونيسي؟
h: Full sentence: Have you ever eaten Indonesian food?

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: ______ your homework yet? (you do)
qa: هل أنجزت واجبك بعد؟
h: Full sentence: Have you done your homework yet?

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: This is the fourth time he ______ my car. (damage)
qa: هذه هي المرة الرابعة التي يفسد فيها سيارتي.
h: Full sentence: This is the fourth time he has damaged my car.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: You ______ a shave! (have)
qa: لقد حلقت ذقنك!
h: Full sentence: You have had a shave!

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: She's got the best voice I ______. (ever hear)
qa: لديها أفضل صوت سمعته.
h: Full sentence: She's got the best voice I have ever heard.

q: Put the verb into the present perfect: He ______ here since eight o'clock. (be)
qa: لقد كان هنا منذ الساعة الثامنة.
h: Full sentence: He has been here since eight o'clock.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? They ______ (write) their exams yesterday.
qa: لقد كتبوا امتحاناتهم بالأمس.
h: Full sentence: They wrote their exams yesterday.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? They ______ (start) building their new house 18 months ago.
qa: لقد بدؤوا بناء منزلهم الجديد منذ 18 شهراً.
h: Full sentence: They started building their new house 18 months ago.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? I ______ (meet) the company manager two weeks ago.
qa: قابلت مدير الشركة منذ أسبوعين.
h: Full sentence: I met the company manager two weeks ago.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? I ______ (be born) in 1964.
qa: ولدت في عام 1964.
h: Full sentence: I was born in 1964.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? That was the best concert I ______ ever ______ (see).
qa: كان ذلك أفضل حفل موسيقي رأيته من قبل.
h: Full sentence: That was the best concert I have ever seen.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? I ______ (not eat) anything since breakfast.
qa: لم آكل أي شيء منذ وجبة الإفطار.
h: Full sentence: I haven't eaten anything since breakfast.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? I ______ (study) English for 10 years.
qa: لقد درست اللغة الإنجليزية لمدة عشر سنوات.
h: Full sentence: I have studied English for 10 years.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? You ______ (change) your address recently.
qa: لقد غيّرت عنوانك مؤخراً.
h: Full sentence: You have changed your address recently.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? When I was 15 I ______ (go) to Dublin.
qa: عندما كان عمري 15 عاماً ذهبت إلى دبلن.
h: Full sentence: When I was 15 I went to Dublin.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? My students ______ (raise) a lot of money for charity.
qa: لقد جمع طلابي الكثير من المال للأعمال الخيرية.
h: Full sentence: My students have raised a lot of money for charity.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? We ______ (not go) to the cinema last night.
qa: لم نذهب إلى السينما الليلة الماضية.
h: Full sentence: We didn't go to the cinema last night.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? My uncle ______ (arrive) in Lisbon last night but he ______ (not call).
qa: وصل عمي إلى لشبونة الليلة الماضية ولكنه لم يتصل.
h: Full sentence: My uncle arrived in Lisbon last night but he didn't call.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? We ______ (not see) Pedro Almodovar's new film yet.
qa: لم نشاهد بعد فيلم بيدرو ألمودوفار الجديد.
h: Full sentence: We haven't seen Pedro Almodovar's new film yet.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? ______ (you go) abroad this year?
qa: هل ذهبت إلى الخارج هذا العام؟
h: Full sentence: Have you gone abroad this year?

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? The shop is probably closed because they ______ (go) for lunch.
qa: من المحتمل أن المتجر مغلق لأنهم ذهبوا لتناول الغداء.
h: Full sentence: The shop is probably closed because they have gone for lunch.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? When I ______ (be) at school I ______ (not like) Maths.
qa: عندما كنت في المدرسة لم أكن أحب الرياضيات.
h: Full sentence: When I was at school I didn't like Maths.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? What's the matter with your brother? He ______ (lose) his mobile.
qa: ما الأمر مع أخيك؟ لقد فقد هاتفه المحمول.
h: Full sentence: He has lost his mobile.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? Mark Spitz ______ (win) seven Olympic gold medals in 1972.
qa: فاز مارك سبيتز بسبع ميداليات ذهبية أولمبية في عام 1972.
h: Full sentence: Mark Spitz won seven Olympic gold medals in 1972.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? Why are you crying? Because I ______ (cut) my finger.
qa: لماذا تبكي؟ لأنني جرحت إصبعي.
h: Full sentence: Because I have cut my finger.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? When Mary was young she ______ (love) skiing.
qa: عندما كانت ماري صغيرة كانت تحب التزلج.
h: Full sentence: When Mary was young she loved skiing.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? There ______ (be) a lot of accidents last year, and there ______ (be) a lot this year, too.
qa: كان هناك الكثير من الحوادث العام الماضي، وهناك الكثير أيضاً هذا العام.
h: Full sentence: There were a lot of accidents last year, and there have been a lot this year, too.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? My students ______ (not study) hard last term, but they ______ (study) hard this term.
qa: لم يدرس طلابي بجد في الفصل الماضي، لكنهم درسوا بجد في هذا الفصل.
h: Full sentence: My students didn't study hard last term, but they have studied hard this term.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? When my niece ______ (be) at school, she ______ (play) in a handball team.
qa: عندما كانت ابنة أختي في المدرسة، كانت تلعب في فريق كرة اليد.
h: Full sentence: When my niece was at school, she played in a handball team.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? After I ______ (leave) school, I ______ (take) a job in the library.
qa: بعد أن غادرت المدرسة، أخذت وظيفة في المكتبة.
h: Full sentence: After I left school, I took a job in the library.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? I'm afraid the last train ______ (leave) an hour ago.
qa: أخشى أن القطار الأخير غادر منذ ساعة.
h: Full sentence: I'm afraid the last train left an hour ago.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? Thank you for your offer but I ______ (decide) not to accept.
qa: شكراً لك على عرضك ولكنني قررت عدم القبول.
h: Full sentence: Thank you for your offer but I have decided not to accept.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? Yesterday I ______ (lose) my wallet.
qa: بالأمس فقدت محفظتي.
h: Full sentence: Yesterday I lost my wallet.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? We ______ (not speak) to your sister for a long time.
qa: لم نتحدث إلى أختك منذ وقت طويل.
h: Full sentence: We haven't spoken to your sister for a long time.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? When we ______ (reach) the cinema, there ______ (not be) any tickets left.
qa: عندما وصلنا إلى السينما، لم يكن هناك أي تذاكر متبقية.
h: Full sentence: When we reached the cinema, there weren't any tickets left.

q: Past Simple or Present Perfect? Take your umbrella with you. It ______ (start) raining.
qa: خذ مظلتك معك. لقد بدأ المطر في الهطول.
h: Full sentence: Take your umbrella with you. It has started raining.

q: Complete the dialogue with the appropriate tenses. Robin: I think the waiter ______ (forget) us. We ______ (wait) here for over half an hour and nobody ______ (take) our order yet.
qa: روبن: أعتقد أن النادل نسينا. نحن ننتظر هنا منذ أكثر من نصف ساعة ولم يأخذ أحد طلبنا بعد.
a: has forgotten; have been waiting; has taken
h: Full sentence: the waiter has forgotten … We have been waiting … nobody has taken our order yet.

q: Michele: I think you're right. He ______ (walk) by us at least twenty times. He probably thinks we ______ (order, already).
qa: ميشيل: أعتقد أنك محق. لقد مرّ بجانبنا عشرين مرة على الأقل. ربما يظن أننا طلبنا بالفعل.
h: Full sentence: He has walked by us at least twenty times. He probably thinks we have already ordered.

q: Robin: Look at that couple over there, they ______ (be, only) here for five or ten minutes and they already have their food.
qa: روبن: انظر إلى ذلك الزوجين هناك، هما هنا منذ خمس أو عشر دقائق فقط ولديهما طعامهما بالفعل.
h: Full sentence: they have only been here for five or ten minutes …

q: Michele: He must realize we ______ (order, not) yet! We ______ (sit) here for over half an hour staring at him.
qa: ميشيل: يجب أن يدرك أننا لم نطلب بعد! نحن نجلس هنا منذ أكثر من نصف ساعة ننظر إليه.
h: Full sentence: He must realize we haven't ordered yet! We have been sitting here for over half an hour …

q: Robin: I don't know if he ______ (notice, even) us. He ______ (run) from table to table taking orders and serving food.
qa: روبن: لا أعلم إن كان قد لاحظ وجودنا أصلاً. إنه يجري من طاولة إلى أخرى يأخذ الطلبات ويقدم الطعام.
a: has even noticed; has been running
h: Full sentence: I don't know if he has even noticed us. He has been running from table to table …

q: Michele: That's true, and he ______ (look, not) in our direction once.
qa: ميشيل: هذا صحيح، ولم ينظر في اتجاهنا ولو مرة واحدة.
h: Full sentence: he hasn't looked in our direction once.

q: Complete: It is already 9:30 PM and I ______ (wait) here for over an hour. If John does not get here in the next five minutes, I am going to leave.
qa: أكمل: الساعة الآن 9:30 مساءً وأنا أنتظر هنا منذ أكثر من ساعة. إذا لم يصل جون خلال الخمس دقائق القادمة، سأغادر.
h: Full sentence: I have been waiting here for over an hour.

q: Complete: I was really angry at John yesterday. By the time he finally arrived, I ______ (wait) for over an hour. I almost left without him.
qa: أكمل: كنت غاضباً جداً من جون أمس. بحلول الوقت الذي وصل فيه أخيراً، كنت أنتظر لأكثر من ساعة. كدت أغادر بدونه.
h: Full sentence: By the time he finally arrived, I had been waiting for over an hour.

q: Complete: Did you hear that Ben was fired last month? He ______ (work) for that import company for more than ten years and he ______ (work) in almost every department.
qa: أكمل: هل سمعت أن بن طُرد الشهر الماضي؟ كان يعمل في شركة الاستيراد تلك لأكثر من عشر سنوات وكان قد عمل في كل قسم تقريباً.
h: Full sentence: He had been working for that import company … and he had worked in almost every department.

q: Complete: I ______ (see) many pictures of the pyramids before I went to Egypt. Pictures of the monuments are very misleading.
qa: أكمل: كنت قد رأيت صوراً كثيرة للأهرامات قبل أن أذهب إلى مصر. صور المعالم مضللة جداً.
h: Full sentence: I had seen many pictures of the pyramids before I went to Egypt.

q: Complete: Sarah ______ (climb) the Matterhorn, ______ (sail) around the world, and ______ (go) on safari in Kenya. She is such an adventurous person.
qa: أكمل: سارة تسلقت جبل ماترهورن وأبحرت حول العالم وذهبت في رحلة سفاري في كينيا. إنها شخص مغامر جداً.
a: has climbed; has sailed; has gone
h: Full sentence: Sarah has climbed …, has sailed …, and has gone on safari in Kenya.

q: Complete: Sarah ______ (climb) …, ______ (sail) … and ______ (go) on safari in Kenya by the time she turned twenty-five. She ______ (experience) more by that age than most people do in their entire lives.
qa: أكمل: كانت سارة قد تسلقت وأبحرت وذهبت في رحلة سفاري في كينيا بحلول الوقت الذي بلغت فيه الخامسة والعشرين. وقد خاضت من التجارب أكثر مما يخوضه معظم الناس في حياتهم كلها.
a: had climbed; had sailed; had gone; had experienced
h: Full sentence: Sarah had climbed, had sailed, and had gone on safari … She had experienced more by that age …

q: Complete: When Melanie came into the office yesterday, her eyes were red and watery. I think she ______ (cry).
qa: أكمل: عندما دخلت ميلاني المكتب أمس، كانت عيناها حمراوين ودامعتين. أعتقد أنها كانت تبكي.
h: Full sentence: I think she had been crying.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? My aunt flew to Paris last year. She ______ (never / go) on a plane before that.
qa: سافرت عمتي إلى باريس العام الماضي. لم تكن قد ركبت طائرة من قبل.
h: Full sentence: She had never gone on a plane before that.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? We didn't need to queue because my wife ______ (already / buy) the tickets.
qa: لم نحتج للوقوف في طابور لأن زوجتي كانت قد اشترت التذاكر بالفعل.
h: Full sentence: … because my wife had already bought the tickets.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? The thieves had already spent the money when the police ______ (catch) them.
qa: كان اللصوص قد أنفقوا المال عندما أمسكت بهم الشرطة.
h: Full sentence: The thieves had already spent the money when the police caught them.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? Helen ______ (split up) with John before she met Paul.
qa: كانت هيلين قد انفصلت عن جون قبل أن تلتقي بـ Paul.
h: Full sentence: Helen had split up with John before she met Paul.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? We ______ (know) her address because she ______ (tell) us.
qa: كنا نعرف عنوانها لأنها أخبرتنا.
h: Full sentence: We knew her address because she had told us.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? The children ______ (not eat) for days so they ______ (be) extremely hungry.
qa: لم يأكل الأطفال لعدة أيام لذلك كانوا جائعين للغاية.
h: Full sentence: The children hadn't eaten for days so they were extremely hungry.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? Everyone ______ (hug) each other after they ______ (finish) their exams.
qa: عانق الجميع بعضهم البعض بعد أن أنهوا امتحاناتهم.
h: Full sentence: Everyone hugged each other after they had finished their exams.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? She didn't want to go to the cinema because she ______ (already / see) the film.
qa: لم ترغب في الذهاب إلى السينما لأنها كانت قد شاهدت الفيلم بالفعل.
h: Full sentence: … because she had already seen the film.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? I ______ (just / buy) a dress when a thief ______ (steal) my bag.
qa: كنت قد اشتريت فستاناً للتو عندما سرق لص حقيبتي.
h: Full sentence: I had just bought a dress when a thief stole my bag.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? My niece ______ (go) to London three times by the time she ______ (be) sixteen.
qa: كانت ابنة أختي قد ذهبت إلى لندن ثلاث مرات بحلول الوقت الذي بلغت فيه السادسة عشرة.
h: Full sentence: My niece had gone to London three times by the time she was sixteen.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? My students ______ (raise) some money after they ______ (see) a documentary on TV about Africa.
qa: جمع طلابي بعض المال بعد أن شاهدوا فيلماً وثائقياً على التلفاز عن إفريقيا.
h: Full sentence: My students raised some money after they had seen a documentary …

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? It was half past three and we still ______ (not / eat) lunch.
qa: كانت الساعة الثالثة والنصف ولم نكن قد تناولنا الغداء بعد.
h: Full sentence: … we still hadn't eaten lunch.

q: Past Simple or Past Perfect? Our teacher ______ (give) us extra homework because we ______ (not finish) our essays.
qa: أعطانا معلمنا واجباً إضافياً لأننا لم ننه مقالاتنا.
h: Full sentence: Our teacher gave us extra homework because we hadn't finished our essays.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? Every Monday, Sally ______ (drive) her kids to football practice.
qa: كل يوم اثنين، تقود سالي أطفالها إلى تدريب كرة القدم.
h: Full sentence: Every Monday, Sally drives her kids to football practice.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? Usually, I ______ (work) as a secretary at ABT, but this summer I ______ (study) French at a language school in Paris.
qa: عادةً أعمل كسكرتيرة في ABT، لكن هذا الصيف أدرس الفرنسية في مدرسة لغات في باريس.
h: Full sentence: Usually, I work as a secretary … this summer I am studying French …

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? Shhhhh! Be quiet! John ______ (sleep).
qa: شششش! اهدأ! جون نائم.
h: Full sentence: John is sleeping.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? Don't forget to take your umbrella. It ______ (rain).
qa: لا تنس أن تأخذ مظلتك. إنها تمطر.
h: Full sentence: It is raining.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? I hate living in Seattle because it ______ (rain, always).
qa: أكره العيش في سياتل لأنها دائماً تمطر.
h: Full sentence: … because it is always raining.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? I'm sorry I can't hear what you ______ (say) because everybody ______ (talk) so loudly.
qa: آسف لا أستطيع سماع ما تقوله لأن الجميع يتحدثون بصوت عالٍ جداً.
h: Full sentence: I can't hear what you are saying because everybody is talking so loudly.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? Justin ______ (write, currently) a book about his adventures in Tibet.
qa: جاستن يكتب حالياً كتاباً عن مغامراته في التبت.
h: Full sentence: Justin is currently writing a book about his adventures in Tibet.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? Do you want to come over for dinner tonight? Oh, I'm sorry, I can't. I ______ (go) to a movie tonight with some friends.
qa: هل تريد أن تأتي لتناول العشاء الليلة؟ آسف لا أستطيع. سأذهب إلى السينما الليلة مع بعض الأصدقاء.
h: Full sentence: I'm sorry, I can't. I am going to a movie tonight with some friends.

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? The business cards ______ (be, normally) printed by a company in New York. Their prices ______ (be) inexpensive, yet the quality of their work is quite good.
qa: تُطبع بطاقات العمل عادةً بواسطة شركة في نيويورك. أسعارها رخيصة، ومع ذلك فجودة عملها جيدة جداً.
h: Full sentence: The business cards are normally printed … Their prices are inexpensive …

q: Simple Present or Present Continuous? This delicious chocolate ______ (be) made by a small chocolatier in Zurich, Switzerland.
qa: هذه الشوكولاتة اللذيذة تُصنع بواسطة صانع شوكولاتة صغير في زيورخ بسويسرا.
h: Full sentence: This delicious chocolate is made by a small chocolatier in Zurich, Switzerland.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? A: What ______ (you, do) when the accident occurred? B: I ______ (try) to change a light bulb that had burnt out.
qa: أ: ماذا كنت تفعل عندما وقع الحادث؟ ب: كنت أحاول تغيير مصباح احترق.
h: Full sentence: A: What were you doing when the accident occurred? B: I was trying to change a light bulb …

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? After I ______ (find) the wallet full of money, I ______ (go, immediately) to the police and ______ (turn) it in.
qa: بعد أن وجدت المحفظة المليئة بالمال، ذهبت فوراً إلى الشرطة وسلمتها.
h: Full sentence: After I found the wallet full of money, I went immediately to the police and turned it in.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? The doctor ______ (say) that Tom ______ (be) too sick to go to work and that he ______ (need) to stay at home for a couple of days.
qa: قال الطبيب إن توم كان مريضاً جداً بحيث لا يستطيع الذهاب إلى العمل وإنه يحتاج للبقاء في المنزل لبضعة أيام.
h: Full sentence: The doctor said that Tom was too sick to go to work and that he needed to stay at home …

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? Sebastian ______ (arrive) at Susan's house a little before 9:00 pm, but she ______ (be, not) there. She ______ (study, at the library) for her final examination in French.
qa: وصل سيباستيان إلى منزل سوزان قبل التاسعة مساءً بقليل لكنها لم تكن هناك. كانت تدرس في المكتبة استعداداً لامتحانها النهائي في الفرنسية.
a: arrived; was not; was studying at the library
h: Full sentence: Sebastian arrived … but she was not there. She was studying at the library …

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? Sandy is in the living room watching television. At this time yesterday, she ______ (watch, also) television.
qa: ساندي الآن في غرفة المعيشة تشاهد التلفاز. في هذا الوقت أمس كانت تشاهد التلفاز أيضاً.
h: Full sentence: At this time yesterday, she was also watching television.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? A: I ______ (call) you last night after dinner, but you ______ (be, not) there. Where were you? B: I ______ (work) out at the fitness center.
qa: أ: اتصلت بك الليلة الماضية بعد العشاء لكنك لم تكن هناك. أين كنت؟ ب: كنت أتمرن في مركز اللياقة البدنية.
h: Full sentence: A: I called you last night … but you weren't there. B: I was working out at the fitness center.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? When I ______ (walk) into the busy office, the secretary ______ (talk) on the phone with a customer.
qa: عندما دخلت المكتب المزدحم كانت السكرتيرة تتحدث على الهاتف مع أحد العملاء.
h: Full sentence: When I walked into the busy office, the secretary was talking on the phone with a customer.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? I ______ (watch) a mystery movie on T.V. when the electricity went out.
qa: كنت أشاهد فيلماً غامضاً على التلفاز عندما انقطعت الكهرباء.
h: Full sentence: I was watching a mystery movie on T.V. when the electricity went out.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? Sharon ______ (be) in the room when John ______ (tell) me what had happened, but she didn't hear anything because she ______ (listen, not).
qa: كانت شارون في الغرفة عندما أخبرني جون بما حدث لكنها لم تسمع شيئاً لأنها لم تكن تستمع.
h: Full sentence: Sharon was in the room when John told me what had happened, but … she was not listening.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? It's strange that you ______ (call) because I ______ (think, just) about you.
qa: من الغريب أنك اتصلت لأنني كنت أفكر بك للتو.
h: Full sentence: It's strange that you called because I was just thinking about you.

q: Simple Past or Past Continuous? The Titanic ______ (cross) the Atlantic when it ______ (strike) an iceberg.
qa: كانت التيتانيك تعبر المحيط الأطلسي عندما اصطدمت بجبل جليدي.
h: Full sentence: The Titanic was crossing the Atlantic when it struck an iceberg.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? A: Did you like the movie "Star Wars"? B: I don't know. I ______ (see, never) that movie.
qa: أ: هل أعجبك فيلم "حرب النجوم"؟ ب: لا أعرف. لم أشاهد ذلك الفيلم قط.
h: Full sentence: I have never seen that movie.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? Sam ______ (arrive) in San Diego a week ago.
qa: وصل سام إلى سان دييغو منذ أسبوع.
h: Full sentence: Sam arrived in San Diego a week ago.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? My best friend and I ______ (know) each other for over fifteen years.
qa: أنا وأفضل صديق لي نعرف بعضنا منذ أكثر من خمس عشرة سنة.
h: Full sentence: My best friend and I have known each other for over fifteen years.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? Stinson is a fantastic writer. He ______ (write) ten very creative short stories in the last year.
qa: ستينسون كاتب رائع. لقد كتب عشر قصص قصيرة مبدعة خلال العام الماضي.
h: Full sentence: He has written ten very creative short stories in the last year.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? I ______ (have, not) this much fun since I ______ (be) a kid.
qa: لم أستمتع بهذا القدر من المرح منذ أن كنت طفلاً.
h: Full sentence: I haven't had this much fun since I was a kid.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? Things ______ (change) a great deal at Coltech, Inc. When we first ______ (start) working here three years ago, the company ______ (have, only) six employees. Since then, we ______ (expand) to include more than 2000 full-time workers.
qa: تغيرت الأمور كثيراً في شركة كولتك. عندما بدأنا العمل هنا قبل ثلاث سنوات كانت الشركة تضم ستة موظفين فقط. ومنذ ذلك الحين توسعنا لنشمل أكثر من 2000 موظف بدوام كامل.
a: have changed; started; only had; have expanded
h: Full sentence: Things have changed … When we first started working here … the company only had six employees. Since then, we have expanded …

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? I ______ (tell) him to stay on the path while he was hiking, but he ______ (wander) off into the forest and ______ (be) bitten by a snake.
qa: قلت له أن يبقى على الطريق أثناء التنزه لكنه تاه في الغابة وتعرض للعض من ثعبان.
h: Full sentence: I told him to stay on the path … but he wandered off into the forest and was bitten by a snake.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? Listen Donna, I don't care if you ______ (miss) the bus this morning. You ______ (be) late to work too many times. You are fired!
qa: اسمعي يا دونا، لا يهمني إن فاتك الباص هذا الصباح. لقد تأخرتِ عن العمل مرات كثيرة جداً. أنتِ مطرودة!
h: Full sentence: I don't care if you missed the bus this morning. You have been late to work too many times.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? Sam is from Colorado, which is hundreds of miles from the coast, so he ______ (see, never) the ocean.
qa: سام من كولورادو التي تبعد مئات الأميال عن الساحل، لذا لم ير المحيط أبداً.
h: Full sentence: … so he has never seen the ocean.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? How sad! George ______ (dream) of going to California before he died, but he didn't make it. He ______ (see, never) the ocean.
qa: يا للأسف! كان جورج يحلم بالذهاب إلى كاليفورنيا قبل أن يموت لكنه لم يتمكن من ذلك. لم ير المحيط أبداً.
h: Full sentence: George dreamed of going to California before he died … He never saw the ocean.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? In the last hundred years, traveling ______ (become) much easier and very comfortable. In the 19th century, it ______ (take) two or three months to cross North America by covered wagon. The trip ______ (be) very rough and often dangerous. Things ______ (change) a great deal in the last hundred and fifty years.
qa: في المئة سنة الأخيرة أصبح السفر أسهل بكثير وأكثر راحة. في القرن التاسع عشر كان عبور أمريكا الشمالية بالعربة المغطاة يستغرق شهرين أو ثلاثة. وكانت الرحلة قاسية جداً وغالباً خطيرة. تغيرت الأمور كثيراً في المئة والخمسين سنة الأخيرة.
a: has become; took; was; have changed
h: Full sentence: … traveling has become much easier … it took two or three months … The trip was very rough … Things have changed a great deal …

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? Jonny, I can't believe how much you ______ (change) since the last time I ______ (see) you. You ______ (grow) at least a foot!
qa: جوني، لا أستطيع أن أصدق كم تغيرت منذ آخر مرة رأيتك فيها. لقد كبرت (طولاً) بما لا يقل عن قدم!
h: Full sentence: … how much you have changed since the last time I saw you. You have grown at least a foot!

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? This tree ______ (be) planted by the settlers who ______ (found) our city over four hundred years ago.
qa: هذه الشجرة زرعها المستوطنون الذين أسسوا مدينتنا منذ أكثر من أربعمئة عام.
h: Full sentence: This tree was planted by the settlers who founded our city over four hundred years ago.

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? This mountain ______ (be, never) climbed by anyone. Several mountaineers ______ (try) to reach the top, but nobody ______ (succeed, ever). The climb is extremely difficult and many people ______ (die) trying to reach the summit.
qa: لم يتسلق هذا الجبل أحد من قبل. حاول عدة متسلقين الوصول إلى القمة لكن لم ينجح أحد قط. التسلق صعب للغاية وقد مات كثير من الناس وهم يحاولون بلوغ القمة.
a: has never been; have tried; has ever succeeded; have died
h: Full sentence: This mountain has never been climbed … Several mountaineers have tried … nobody has ever succeeded … many people have died …

q: Simple Past or Present Perfect? I ______ (visit, never) Africa, but I ______ (travel) to South America several times. The last time I ______ (go) to South America, I ______ (visit) Brazil and Peru. I ______ (spend) two weeks in the Amazon, ______ (hike) for a week near Machu Picchu, and ______ (fly) over the Nazca Lines.
qa: لم أزر إفريقيا قط لكنني سافرت إلى أمريكا الجنوبية عدة مرات. آخر مرة ذهبت فيها زرت البرازيل والبيرو. قضيت أسبوعين في الأمازون وتنزهت أسبوعاً قرب ماتشو بيتشو وحلّقت فوق خطوط نازكا.
a: have never visited; have traveled; went; visited; spent; hiked; flew
h: Full sentence: I have never visited Africa, but I have traveled … The last time I went … I visited … spent … hiked … flew …

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? When I ______ (arrive) home last night, I discovered that Jane ______ (prepare) a beautiful candle-lit dinner.
qa: عندما وصلت إلى المنزل الليلة الماضية اكتشفت أن جين كانت قد أعدّت عشاءً جميلاً مضاءً بالشموع.
h: Full sentence: When I arrived home last night, I discovered that Jane had prepared a beautiful candle-lit dinner.

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? Since I began acting, I ______ (perform) in two plays, a television commercial and a TV drama. However, I ______ (speak, never even) publicly before I came to Hollywood in 1985.
qa: منذ أن بدأت التمثيل قدمت عرضين مسرحيين وإعلاناً تلفزيونياً ودراما تلفزيونية. لكنني لم أكن قد تحدثت علناً من قبل أن آتي إلى هوليوود عام 1985.
a: have performed; had never even spoken
h: Full sentence: Since I began acting, I have performed … I had never even spoken publicly before I came to Hollywood …

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? By the time I got to the office, the meeting ______ (begin, already) without me. My boss ______ (be) furious with me and I ______ (be) fired.
qa: بحلول الوقت الذي وصلت فيه إلى المكتب كان الاجتماع قد بدأ بالفعل من دوني. كان مديري غاضباً جداً مني وتم طردي.
h: Full sentence: By the time I got to the office, the meeting had already begun without me. My boss was furious … I was fired.

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? When I ______ (turn) the radio on yesterday, I ______ (hear) a song that was popular when I was in high school. I ______ (hear, not) the song in years, and it ______ (bring) back some great memories.
qa: عندما شغلت الراديو أمس سمعت أغنية كانت مشهورة عندما كنت في المدرسة الثانوية. لم أسمع الأغنية منذ سنوات وقد أعادت إلي ذكريات رائعة.
h: Full sentence: When I turned the radio on yesterday, I heard a song … I hadn't heard the song in years, and it brought back some great memories.

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? Last week, I ______ (run) into an ex-girlfriend of mine. We ______ (see, not) each other in years, and both of us ______ (change) a great deal. I ______ (enjoy) talking to her so much that I ______ (ask) her out on a date.
qa: الأسبوع الماضي قابلت بالصدفة صديقة سابقة لي. لم نر بعضنا منذ سنوات وكلانا تغير كثيراً. استمتعت بالحديث معها لدرجة أنني طلبت منها الخروج معي في موعد.
a: ran; hadn't seen; had changed; enjoyed; asked
h: Full sentence: Last week, I ran into an ex-girlfriend of mine. We hadn't seen each other in years, and both of us had changed a great deal. I enjoyed talking … I asked her out …

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? When Jack ______ (enter) the room, I ______ (recognize, not) him because he ______ (lose) so much weight and ______ (grow) a beard.
qa: عندما دخل جاك الغرفة لم أتعرف عليه لأنه فقد الكثير من الوزن وأطلق لحيته.
a: entered; didn't recognize; had lost; had grown
h: Full sentence: When Jack entered the room, I didn't recognize him because he had lost so much weight and had grown a beard.

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? The Maya established a very advanced civilization in the jungles of the Yucatan; however, their culture ______ (disappear, virtually) by the time Europeans first ______ (arrive) in the New World.
qa: أسس المايا حضارة متقدمة جداً في غابات يوكاتان؛ ومع ذلك كانت ثقافتهم قد اختفت تقريباً بحلول الوقت الذي وصل فيه الأوروبيون لأول مرة إلى العالم الجديد.
h: Full sentence: … their culture had virtually disappeared by the time Europeans first arrived in the New World.

q: Simple Past, Present Perfect or Past Perfect? I ______ (visit) so many beautiful places since I ______ (come) to Utah. Before moving here, I ______ (hear, never) of Bryce Canyon, Zion, Arches or Canyonlands.
qa: زرت أماكن جميلة كثيرة منذ أن جئت إلى يوتا. قبل أن أنتقل إلى هنا لم أكن قد سمعت أبداً عن برايس كانيون أو زايون أو آرتشز أو كانيونلاندز.
a: have visited; came; had never heard
h: Full sentence: I have visited so many beautiful places since I came to Utah. … I had never heard of Bryce Canyon …

q: What is Step 1 of writing a good paragraph?
qa: ما هي الخطوة الأولى لكتابة فقرة جيدة؟
o: Decide the topic of your paragraph
e: Step 1: Decide the topic of your paragraph.

q: What is Step 2 of writing a good paragraph?
qa: ما هي الخطوة الثانية لكتابة فقرة جيدة؟
e: Step 2: Develop a topic sentence.

q: What is Step 3 of writing a good paragraph?
qa: ما هي الخطوة الثالثة لكتابة فقرة جيدة؟
e: Step 3: Demonstrate your point.

q: What is Step 4 of writing a good paragraph?
qa: ما هي الخطوة الرابعة لكتابة فقرة جيدة؟
e: Step 4: Conclude.

q: What is the last step in good paragraph writing?
qa: ما هي الخطوة الأخيرة في كتابة فقرة جيدة؟
e: Step 5: the last step in good paragraph writing is proofreading and revision.

q: Which of the following is NOT listed as information you can add to your paragraph in Step 3?
qa: أي مما يلي ليس من المعلومات التي يمكن إضافتها لفقرتك في الخطوة 3؟
e: Irrelevant sentences are something to remove when proofreading ("Does it include any irrelevant sentences?").
ea: الجمل غير ذات الصلة يجب حذفها عند المراجعة.

q: Which question is asked before you begin writing (Step 1)?
qa: أي سؤال يُطرح على نفسك قبل أن تبدأ الكتابة (الخطوة 1)؟
o: On what topic am I supposed to be writing?
Does it include any irrelevant sentences?
oa: عن أي موضوع من المفترض أن أكتب؟
هل تتضمن جملاً غير ذات صلة؟
e: Step 1 questions: On what topic am I supposed to be writing? What do I know about this topic already? …
ea: من أسئلة الخطوة 1: عن أي موضوع من المفترض أن أكتب؟

q: Which is a question to ask yourself when you look over and proofread your paragraph?
qa: أي سؤال تسأله لنفسك عند مراجعة فقرتك؟
o: What examples can I use to support my point?
What do I know about this topic already?
Where can I go to find some answers?
oa: ما الأمثلة التي يمكنني استخدامها لدعم فكرتي؟
ماذا أعرف عن هذا الموضوع بالفعل؟
e: Step 5 questions: Does my paragraph develop the topic? Is it well organized? Does it have unity? …
ea: من أسئلة الخطوة 5: هل هي منظمة جيداً؟

q: Good topic sentences should always contain:
qa: جمل الموضوع الجيدة يجب أن تحتوي دائماً على:
o: A topic and a controlling idea
e: Good topic sentences should always contain both (1) a topic and (2) a controlling idea.
ea: جملة الموضوع الجيدة تحتوي على موضوع وفكرة مسيطرة.

q: The topic of a paragraph is:
qa: موضوع الفقرة هو:
o: The last sentence of the paragraph
The main subject matter or idea covered in the paragraph
The idea that gives direction to the composition
oa: الفكرة أو المضمون الرئيسي الذي تتناوله الفقرة
e: The topic – the main subject matter or idea covered in the paragraph.
ea: الموضوع هو الفكرة الرئيسية التي تتناولها الفقرة.

q: The controlling idea:
qa: الفكرة المسيطرة:
o: Is the main subject matter of the paragraph
Restates the paragraph at the end
Focuses the topic by providing direction to the composition
e: The controlling idea – this idea focuses the topic by providing direction to the composition.
ea: الفكرة المسيطرة تركز الموضوع وتعطيه اتجاهاً.

q: In the topic sentence "There are several advantages to online education", the topic is:
qa: في جملة الموضوع "There are several advantages to online education" الموضوع هو:
e: The sentence is about online education; "several advantages" is the controlling idea (what is said about the topic).
ea: الجملة عن التعليم عبر الإنترنت، و"عدة مزايا" هي الفكرة المسيطرة.

q: Which of these is a concluding-sentence characteristic mentioned in the book?
qa: أي مما يلي من خصائص الجملة الختامية المذكورة في الكتاب؟
o: Using linking words such as therefore, thus, resulting
oa: استخدام كلمات ربط مثل therefore و thus و resulting
e: Concluding sentences: summarizing the points, repeating words from the topic sentence, using linking words that indicate conclusions.
ea: من خصائصها: التلخيص وتكرار كلمات جملة الموضوع واستخدام كلمات الاستنتاج.

q: An apostrophe is used:
qa: يُستخدم الأبوستروف (') في:
o: To replace a missing letter, to show possession, and in the plural of letters
At the end of a question
oa: لتعويض حرف ناقص ولإظهار الملكية ومع جمع الحروف
e: An apostrophe substitutes for missing letters (can't), shows possession (Jane's room) and is used in plural of letters, some numbers and abbreviations.
ea: الأبوستروف لتعويض حرف ناقص وللملكية ولجمع الحروف.

q: A colon (:) is used:
qa: تُستخدم النقطتان (:) في:
o: Before a list or quote, between hours and minutes, and in a ratio
At the end of a question
oa: قبل قائمة أو اقتباس وبين الساعات والدقائق وفي النسبة
e: A colon is used before a list or quote, to separate hours and minutes and elements of a mathematical ratio.
ea: النقطتان قبل القائمة أو الاقتباس وبين الساعات والدقائق وفي النسبة.

q: A comma is used:
qa: تُستخدم الفاصلة (,) في:
o: To show exact words that were said
To separate phrases or items in a list
To note the end of a declarative sentence
oa: للفصل بين العبارات أو عناصر القائمة
e: A comma is used to separate phrases or items in a list (She bought milk, eggs, and bread).
ea: الفاصلة للفصل بين العبارات أو عناصر القائمة.

q: An exclamation point (!) is used to show:
qa: تُستخدم علامة التعجب (!) لإظهار:
o: The end of a declarative sentence
e: An exclamation point is used to show excitement or emphasis.
ea: علامة التعجب لإظهار الحماس أو التأكيد.

q: A period (.) is used to note the end of:
qa: تُستخدم النقطة (.) لإنهاء:
e: A period is used to note the end of a declarative sentence.

q: A question mark (?) is used:
qa: تُستخدم علامة الاستفهام (?) في:
o: At the end of a declarative sentence
At the end of a question
e: A question mark is used at the end of a question.

q: Quotation marks (" ") are used:
qa: تُستخدم علامتا الاقتباس (" ") في:
o: At the beginning and end of a phrase to show it is written exactly as it was said or written
To separate items in a list
oa: في بداية ونهاية عبارة لإظهار أنها مكتوبة بالضبط كما قيلت أو كُتبت
e: Quotation marks show a phrase is written exactly as originally said or written (She said, "Let's eat.").
ea: علامتا الاقتباس لإظهار الكلام كما قيل أو كُتب.

q: A semicolon (;) separates:
qa: تفصل الفاصلة المنقوطة (;) بين:
o: Two independent clauses in a compound sentence
e: A semicolon separates two independent clauses in a compound sentence; it also separates items in a series where commas are already in use.
ea: تفصل بين جملتين مستقلتين وبين عناصر السلسلة التي بها فواصل.

q: Which sentence uses the colon correctly?
qa: أي جملة تستخدم النقطتين بشكل صحيح؟
e: A colon separates hours and minutes (The time is 2:15).

q: Which sentence is correctly punctuated?
qa: أي جملة علامات ترقيمها صحيحة؟
o: Dot your i"s and cross your t"s.
Dot your i;s and cross your t;s.
Dot your is and cross your ts?
Dot your i's and cross your t's.
oa: Dot your i"s and cross your t"s.
Dot your i;s and cross your t;s.
Dot your is and cross your ts?
Dot your i's and cross your t's.
e: The apostrophe is used in the plural of letters (i's, t's).

q: Which sentence uses the semicolon correctly?
qa: أي جملة تستخدم الفاصلة المنقوطة بشكل صحيح؟
o: Class; was canceled today Mr. Smith was home sick.
Class was canceled today; Mr. Smith was home sick.
Class was; canceled today Mr. Smith was home sick.
Class was canceled today Mr. Smith; was home sick.
oa: Class; was canceled today Mr. Smith was home sick.
Class was canceled today; Mr. Smith was home sick.
Class was; canceled today Mr. Smith was home sick.
Class was canceled today Mr. Smith; was home sick.
e: The semicolon separates two independent clauses.
ea: الفاصلة المنقوطة تفصل بين جملتين مستقلتين.

q: Choose the correctly punctuated version of: "did you understand why i was upset"
qa: اختر الصيغة الصحيحة علامات ترقيمها: "did you understand why i was upset"
o: Did you understand why I was upset?
Did you understand, why I was upset!
Did you understand why I was upset.
did you understand why I was upset?
oa: Did you understand why I was upset?
Did you understand, why I was upset!
Did you understand why I was upset.
did you understand why I was upset?
e: It is a question, so it starts with a capital letter, "I" is capital, and it ends with a question mark.
ea: هي سؤال: حرف كبير في البداية و I كبيرة وعلامة استفهام في النهاية.

q: Choose the correctly punctuated version of: "we had a great time in france the kids really enjoyed it"
qa: اختر الصيغة الصحيحة: "we had a great time in france the kids really enjoyed it"
o: we had a great time in France the kids really enjoyed it.
We had a great time in France: the kids really enjoyed it?
We had a great time in france, the kids really enjoyed it
We had a great time in France; the kids really enjoyed it.
oa: we had a great time in France the kids really enjoyed it.
We had a great time in France: the kids really enjoyed it?
We had a great time in france, the kids really enjoyed it
We had a great time in France; the kids really enjoyed it.
e: Two independent clauses are joined with a semicolon; capital letters for We and France; period at the end.
ea: جملتان مستقلتان تُفصلان بفاصلة منقوطة مع حروف كبيرة ونقطة.

q: Choose the correctly punctuated version of: "the girls father sat in a corner"
qa: اختر الصيغة الصحيحة: "the girls father sat in a corner"
o: The girl;s father sat in a corner
The girl's father sat in a corner.
The girls' father sat, in a corner!
The girls father sat in a corner.
oa: The girl;s father sat in a corner
The girl's father sat in a corner.
The girls' father sat, in a corner!
The girls father sat in a corner.
e: The apostrophe shows the possessive case (the girl's father).

q: Which is NOT one of the three sentence boundary problems?
qa: أي مما يلي ليس من مشاكل حدود الجملة الثلاث؟
e: The three areas are fragments, comma splices and fused sentences.
ea: المشاكل الثلاث: الجمل الناقصة والفاصلة الواصلة والجمل المندمجة.

q: A fragment:
qa: الجملة الناقصة (Fragment):
o: Lacks a subject or a predicate (main verb), or is a dependent clause not joined to an independent clause
Joins two independent clauses with a comma
Joins independent clauses with no punctuation
oa: تفتقد فاعلاً أو مسنداً (فعلاً رئيسياً) أو هي جملة تابعة غير مرتبطة بجملة مستقلة
e: Fragments lack subjects or predicates, or may be a dependent clause not joined to an independent clause.
ea: الجملة الناقصة تفتقد فاعلاً أو فعلاً رئيسياً أو هي جملة تابعة منفصلة.

q: Which is NOT one of the three tests for fragments?
qa: أي مما يلي ليس من الاختبارات الثلاثة للجمل الناقصة؟
o: Look for subordinating conjunctions or relative pronouns
oa: ابحث عن أدوات ربط تابعة أو ضمائر موصولة
e: The tests are: look for a verb, look for a subject, look for subordinating conjunctions/relative pronouns.
ea: الاختبارات: الفعل والفاعل وأدوات الربط التابعة/الضمائر الموصولة.

q: Which of these are relative pronouns?
qa: أي مما يلي ضمائر موصولة؟
e: Relative pronouns: who, which, that (they construct dependent adjectival clauses).

q: Which of these are subordinating conjunctions?
qa: أي مما يلي أدوات ربط تابعة؟
e: Subordinating conjunctions (when, while, because, etc.) construct dependent adverbial clauses.
ea: أدوات الربط التابعة: when, while, because.

q: "Even though the president attended the meeting." is a fragment because:
qa: الجملة "Even though the president attended the meeting." ناقصة لأنها:
o: It is a dependent clause beginning with a subordinating conjunction
oa: جملة تابعة تبدأ بأداة ربط تابعة
e: "Even though" is a subordinating conjunction; the clause is dependent and not joined to an independent clause. Fix: remove "Even though".
ea: Even though أداة ربط تابعة، والحل حذفها.

q: How do you fix the fragment "Even though the president attended the meeting"?
qa: كيف تصحح الجملة الناقصة "Even though the president attended the meeting"؟
o: Remove the subordinating conjunction: "The president attended the meeting."
e: Convert the dependent clause to an independent clause by eliminating the subordinating conjunction.
ea: حوّل الجملة التابعة إلى مستقلة بحذف أداة الربط.

q: The process of maturation is lifelong. But is most critical during adolescence. — How can the fragment be fixed?
qa: The process of maturation is lifelong. But is most critical during adolescence. — كيف تصحح الجملة الناقصة؟
o: Give it its own subject or rejoin the two halves
oa: أعطها فاعلها الخاص أو اربط النصفين
e: A separated compound predicate becomes a fragment: either give it its own subject or rejoin the two halves.
ea: إما إعطاء الجزء المنفصل فاعله أو إعادة ربط النصفين.

q: A comma splice is:
qa: الفاصلة الواصلة (Comma splice) هي:
o: Independent clauses joined with no punctuation
Two independent clauses joined with a comma
e: Comma splices: independent clauses joined with a comma.
ea: الفاصلة الواصلة: جملتان مستقلتان مربوطتان بفاصلة.

q: A fused sentence is:
qa: الجملة المندمجة (Fused sentence) هي:
o: Independent clauses joined with no punctuation
A question without a question mark
A dependent clause that stands alone
Two independent clauses joined with a comma
oa: جمل مستقلة مربوطة بلا أي ترقيم
e: Fused sentences: independent clauses joined with no punctuation.
ea: الجمل المندمجة: جمل مستقلة بلا ترقيم بينها.

q: Which of these often signals a fused sentence or comma splice?
qa: أي مما يلي غالباً يدل على جملة مندمجة أو فاصلة واصلة؟
o: Conjunctive adverbs such as however, furthermore, thus, therefore
oa: ظروف الربط مثل however و furthermore و thus و therefore
e: Conjunctive adverbs and transitional expressions often signal fused sentences or comma splices.
ea: ظروف الربط وعبارات الانتقال تدل غالباً على المشكلة.

q: Using pronouns like he, she, they, it, this or that in the same sentence as the antecedent usually signals:
qa: استخدام ضمائر مثل he, she, they, it, this, that في نفس الجملة مع المرجع يدل عادةً على:
o: A fused sentence or comma splice
e: This is one of the identification tips in the book.
ea: هذه إحدى طرق التعرف في الكتاب.

qa: أي صيغة تربط جمل Churchill باستخدام فاصلة منقوطة؟

Winston Churchill served his country well in WWI, and he became a leader of distinction.

qa: أي صيغة تربط الجمل باستخدام أداة ربط تابعة؟

qa: أي صيغة تصلح الجمل بفصلها إلى جملتين؟
