e: Link by combining sentences (book example).
ea: مثال الكتاب: دمج الجمل في جملتين منفصلتين.

q: The past continuous is formed with:
qa: يتكون الماضي المستمر من:
e: Examples in the book: I was sleeping, you were working, they were watching a film. (Note: the book's "Form" line printing "had + past participle" is a misprint.)
ea: أمثلة الكتاب: I was sleeping / they were watching. (سطر الصيغة المطبوع had + p.p خطأ مطبعي في الكتاب).

q: How do we make a yes/no question in the past continuous?
qa: كيف نكوّن سؤال نعم/لا في الماضي المستمر؟
o: Put did in front of the subject
Put was / were in front of the subject
Put the verb at the end only
e: To make a yes/no question, put was/were in front of the subject (Was I listening? Were you working?).

q: Which sentence is a correct wh-question in the past continuous?
qa: أي جملة سؤال صحيح بأداة استفهام في الماضي المستمر؟
e: Put the question word at the beginning, then was/were + subject + verb-ing.
ea: أداة الاستفهام في البداية ثم was/were + الفاعل + الفعل ing.

q: "I was having dinner at 6 pm last night." The past continuous is used to say that an action:
qa: "I was having dinner at 6 pm last night." يُستخدم الماضي المستمر للتعبير عن حدث:
o: Started in the past and continues now
Was in progress at a particular time in the past
oa: كان جارياً في وقت محدد في الماضي
e: Use 1: an action in progress at a particular time in the past; it had started but not finished.
ea: الاستخدام الأول: حدث جارٍ في وقت معين في الماضي.

q: In "She was eating when the phone rang", which action is the longer background action?
qa: في "She was eating when the phone rang" أي حدث هو الأطول (الخلفية)؟
e: Past continuous refers to the longer/background action; past simple to the shorter action that interrupted it.
ea: المستمر للحدث الأطول، والبسيط للحدث القصير الذي قطعه.

q: "Grandpa was always telling us funny stories." The past continuous with "always" is used for:
qa: "Grandpa was always telling us funny stories." الماضي المستمر مع always يُستخدم لـ:
e: Past continuous is used with words such as always to talk about things that happened repeatedly.

q: Who was the ruler of Ancient Egypt?
qa: من كان حاكم مصر القديمة؟
e: The Pharaoh was the ruler of Ancient Egypt.

q: The Pharaoh was in charge of:
qa: كان الفرعون مسؤولاً عن:
o: The army, going to war when his lands were threatened
Building the pyramids with his hands
oa: الجيش والذهاب للحرب عند تهديد أراضيه
e: The Pharaoh was in charge of the army and would go to war when his lands were threatened.
ea: الفرعون مسؤول عن الجيش ويذهب للحرب عند تهديد أراضيه.

q: Who helped the Pharaoh in governing the land?
qa: من ساعد الفرعون في حكم البلاد؟
o: An elaborate organization of officials, scribes and overseers
e: An elaborate organization of officials, scribes and overseers helped the Pharaoh in governing the land.
ea: منظومة من المسؤولين والكتبة والمشرفين ساعدت الفرعون.

q: What did the Vizier do?
qa: ماذا كان يفعل الوزير الأكبر (Vizier)؟
o: Represented the Pharaoh in the administration of the land, treasury and legal system
oa: مثّل الفرعون في إدارة الأرض والخزانة والنظام القانوني
e: The Vizier represented the Pharaoh in the administration of the land, treasury and legal system.
ea: مثّل الوزير الفرعون في إدارة الأرض والخزانة والنظام القانوني.

q: Ra was the:
qa: رع (Ra) كان:
e: Ra, the sun god; Isis, goddess of nature and magic; Horus, god of war; Osiris, god of the dead.

q: Osiris was the:
qa: أوزوريس كان:
e: Osiris, the god of the dead.

q: Isis was the goddess of:
qa: إيزيس كانت إلهة:
e: Isis, the goddess of nature and magic.

q: Horus was the god of:
qa: حورس كان إله:
e: Horus, the god of war.

q: Why did the god Amun become the chief god?
qa: لماذا أصبح الإله آمون الإله الأكبر؟
o: Because the kings of Thebes were ruling all Egypt
oa: لأن ملوك طيبة كانوا يحكمون كل مصر
e: The rise and fall of gods mirrored the political fortunes of the temples; when the kings of Thebes ruled all Egypt, Amun became the chief god and was united with Ra (Amun-Ra).
ea: صعود الآلهة وسقوطها انعكاس للظروف السياسية للمعابد.

q: Who owned the land in Ancient Egypt?
qa: من كان يملك الأرض في مصر القديمة؟
o: The Pharaoh, the temples, or a noble family
oa: الفرعون أو المعابد أو عائلة نبيلة
e: The land was owned by the Pharaoh, by one of the temples, or by a noble family.
ea: الأرض مملوكة للفرعون أو المعابد أو عائلة نبيلة.

q: Farmers in Ancient Egypt also:
qa: كان الفلاحون في مصر القديمة أيضاً:
o: Paid a labor tax and sometimes worked on public projects such as irrigation or construction
oa: يدفعون ضريبة عمل ويعملون أحياناً في مشاريع عامة كالري والبناء
e: Farmers paid a labor tax and were at times required to work on public projects.
ea: الفلاحون يدفعون ضريبة عمل ويعملون في مشاريع عامة.

q: Which group had a higher status than farmers?
qa: أي فئة كانت مكانتها أعلى من الفلاحين؟
e: Craftsmen seem to have had a higher status than farmers.
ea: يبدو أن الحرفيين كانت مكانتهم أعلى من الفلاحين.

q: Slaves in Ancient Egypt were mostly used as:
qa: كان العبيد في مصر القديمة يُستخدمون في الغالب:
oa: خدماً في المنازل لدى الأسر الغنية
e: Most slaves seem to have been used as domestic servants in wealthy families.
ea: معظم العبيد كانوا خدماً في المنازل لدى الأسر الغنية.

q: Which was NOT a right of women in Ancient Egypt, according to the text?
qa: أي مما يلي لم يكن من حقوق المرأة في مصر القديمة حسب النص؟
e: Women could own and sell property, make contracts, marry and divorce, receive inheritance and pursue legal disputes in court.
ea: المذكور: الملكية والعقود والزواج والطلاق والميراث والتقاضي.

q: Much of the art that has come down to us is:
qa: معظم الفن الذي وصلنا هو:
o: Funerary art designed for the tomb
e: Much of the art is funerary art – designed for the tomb.

q: Why were the dead accompanied in their graves by everyday and luxury goods?
qa: لماذا كان الموتى يُدفنون ومعهم أشياء يومية وفاخرة؟
o: The Egyptians believed life could continue into the afterlife
oa: لأنهم آمنوا أن الحياة تستمر في الآخرة
e: They believed life could continue into the afterlife, so goods helped them enjoy their new life.

q: The construction of pyramids was:
qa: بناء الأهرامات كان:
o: Restricted to the earlier days of Egyptian civilization
Done only in the last days
oa: مقصوراً على الأيام الأولى للحضارة المصرية
e: The construction of pyramids was restricted to the earlier days of Egyptian civilization.
ea: بناء الأهرامات اقتصر على الفترات المبكرة.

q: Later monumental architecture can be seen most clearly in:
qa: العمارة الضخمة اللاحقة تظهر أوضح في:
o: The temples and giant statues of the Valley of the Kings and Abu Simbel
oa: معابد وتماثيل وادي الملوك وأبو سمبل
e: Later monumental architecture – temples and giant statues of the Valley of the Kings and Abu Simbel.
ea: المعابد والتماثيل العملاقة في وادي الملوك وأبو سمبل.

q: The average Egyptian lived in:
qa: كان المصري العادي يعيش في:
o: A large multi-room house with painted walls
A simple mud, wood or brick house
oa: بيت كبير متعدد الغرف بجدران مزخرفة
بيت بسيط من الطين أو الخشب أو الطوب
e: The average Egyptian lived in a simple mud, wood or brick house; the elite had large multi-room houses.
ea: العادي في بيت بسيط، والنخبة في بيوت كبيرة.

q: Ancient Egyptian doctors could:
qa: كان الأطباء المصريون القدماء قادرين على:
o: Stitch up wounds, repair broken bones and amputate infected limbs
oa: خياطة الجروح وجبر العظام المكسورة وبتر الأطراف المصابة بالعدوى
e: Ancient Egyptian doctors could stitch up wounds, repair broken bones and amputate infected limbs.
ea: خياطة الجروح وجبر العظام وبتر الأطراف المصابة.

q: The present perfect is formed with:
qa: يتكون المضارع التام من:
e: Form: Subject + have OR has + Past Participle + Complement.

q: The present perfect is used to indicate:
qa: يُستخدم المضارع التام للدلالة على:
o: A fixed time in the past
A link between the present and the past
A habit in the past only
e: The present perfect indicates a link between the present and the past; the time is before now but not specified.
ea: يربط الحاضر بالماضي والوقت غير محدد.

q: Which sentence describes an action that started in the past and continues in the present?
qa: أي جملة تصف حدثاً بدأ في الماضي ويستمر في الحاضر؟
o: I have lived in Bristol since 1984.
I was living in Bristol yesterday.
oa: I have lived in Bristol since 1984.
I was living in Bristol yesterday.
e: "I have lived in Bristol since 1984 (= and I still do)."
ea: المثال من الكتاب (وما زلت أعيش هناك).

q: "I have just finished my work." The present perfect with "just" describes:
qa: "I have just finished my work." المضارع التام مع just يصف:
o: An action completed in the very recent past
oa: حدثاً اكتمل في الماضي القريب جداً
e: Actions completed in the very recent past are expressed by "just".
ea: just تعبر عن الأحداث المكتملة في الماضي القريب جداً.

q: "We have visited Portugal several times." This use describes:
qa: "We have visited Portugal several times." هذا الاستخدام يصف:
o: A repeated action in an unspecified period between the past and now
A single action at a fixed time
oa: حدثاً متكرراً في فترة غير محددة بين الماضي والآن
e: Repeated action in an unspecified period between the past and now.
ea: حدث متكرر في فترة غير محددة.

q: Which is the negative form of "She has visited"?
qa: ما الصيغة المنفية لـ "She has visited"؟
e: Negative: To have + not + past participle (has not / hasn't visited).
ea: المنفي: has not / hasn't + التصريف الثالث.

q: Which is the interrogative form of "She has visited"?
qa: ما صيغة السؤال لـ "She has visited"؟
e: Interrogative: To have + subject + past participle.

q: China's present population is approximately:
qa: عدد سكان الصين الحالي يقارب:
o: 1.2 billion, about one fifth of the earth's population
e: China's present population is approximately 1.2 billion, about one fifth of the earth's entire population.
ea: سكان الصين نحو 1.2 مليار أي خُمس سكان الأرض.

q: In which year did China start a stronger program to control the increasing population?
qa: في أي عام بدأت الصين برنامجاً أقوى للسيطرة على زيادة السكان؟
e: In 1979, a stronger program was made to control the increasing population.

q: Why were there no major effects of the early family planning program?
qa: لماذا لم يكن لبرنامج تنظيم الأسرة المبكر آثار كبيرة؟
o: Because of a lack of understanding about the seriousness of the problem and a lack of a clear policy
oa: بسبب نقص فهم خطورة المشكلة وغياب سياسة واضحة
e: Due to a lack of understanding about the seriousness of the problem and a lack of a clear policy, there were no major effects.

q: The "one child" policy indicates that:
qa: تعني سياسة "الطفل الواحد" أن:
o: All couples must have two children
Each couple living in the cities should have only one child, unless one or both are from an ethnic minority
oa: كل زوجين في المدن ينجبان طفلاً واحداً ما لم يكن أحدهما أو كلاهما من أقلية عرقية
e: Each couple living in the cities should have only one child, unless one or both of the couple are from an ethnic minority.
ea: طفل واحد لكل زوجين في المدن إلا الأقليات العرقية.

q: What must couples receive before pregnancy?
qa: ماذا يجب أن يحصل عليه الزوجان قبل الحمل؟
o: A birth coupon giving permission to have a child
oa: قسيمة ولادة تعطيهم إذن إنجاب طفل
e: Couples must receive a birth coupon giving them permission to have a child before pregnancy.

q: What happens when a birth is unauthorized?
qa: ماذا يحدث عند ولادة غير مصرح بها؟
e: An unauthorized birth causes high fines; the child is not counted and is not eligible for medical care, school and employment.
ea: الولادة غير المصرح بها تسبب غرامات عالية.

q: According to government officials, the policy has prevented at least:
qa: حسب المسؤولين الحكوميين منعت السياسة ما لا يقل عن:
e: Preventing at least 250 million births since 1980.

q: Critics say the policy has led in some cases to:
qa: يقول النقاد إن السياسة أدت في بعض الحالات إلى:
o: The killing of female infants because of the traditional preference for boys
oa: قتل الرضع الإناث بسبب تفضيل الأولاد تقليدياً
e: Critics say it has led in some cases to the killing of female infants because of the traditional preference for boys.

q: Why do parents in the countryside need children?
qa: لماذا يحتاج الآباء في الريف إلى الأطفال؟
o: To work in the fields and support them when they are older
oa: للعمل في الحقول ودعمهم عندما يكبرون
e: Children are needed to work in the fields; parents need children to support them, unlike city parents who receive retirement pensions.
ea: الأطفال يعملون في الحقول ويعيلون آباءهم.

q: Conversations should be like a game of:
qa: يجب أن تكون المحادثات مثل لعبة:
e: Conversations should be like a game of ping pong: you wait for the ball, then you hit it back.

q: Conversation strategies are:
qa: استراتيجيات المحادثة هي:
o: The strategies speakers use to manage conversations
oa: الاستراتيجيات التي يستخدمها المتحدثون لإدارة المحادثات
e: Strategies speakers use to manage conversations, e.g. to show/check understanding, start and end conversations, involve other speakers.

q: According to the text, good questions are:
qa: حسب النص الأسئلة الجيدة:
o: Clear, relevant and specific, and open-ended
e: Good questions are clear, relevant, specific, open-ended, and encourage personal reflection.
ea: واضحة ومحددة ومفتوحة وتشجع التفكير الشخصي.

q: The best listeners:
qa: أفضل المستمعين:
o: Ask follow-up questions, going deeper each time, like peeling an onion
oa: يسألون أسئلة متابعة ويتعمقون كل مرة كتقشير البصل
e: The best listeners never stop with just one question. Like peeling an onion, they ask follow-up questions.

q: "Pay attention" in active listening means:
qa: "Pay attention" في الاستماع الفعال تعني:
o: Plan your answer while he talks
Give your partner your full attention rather than thinking about what you want to say
oa: أعطِ شريكك كامل انتباهك بدلاً من التفكير فيما تريد قوله
e: Pay attention: give your partner your full attention rather than thinking about what you want to say while he is still talking.

q: Which phrase is used to ask for clarification?
qa: أي عبارة تُستخدم لطلب التوضيح؟
e: Restating what you heard for clarification ("So, you're saying that…", "Are you saying…?", "Did you mean…?").
ea: إعادة صياغة ما سمعت لطلب التوضيح.

q: Which phrase is used to check understanding?
qa: أي عبارة تُستخدم للتحقق من الفهم؟
o: "It sounds like you were really frustrated."
oa: "It sounds like you were really frustrated."
e: Check understanding: "Are you following?", "You know what I mean?", "You understand my point?".
ea: للتحقق من الفهم نسأل: Are you following?

q: "It sounds like you were really frustrated" is an example of:
qa: "It sounds like you were really frustrated" مثال على:
e: Acknowledge feelings: don't be afraid to acknowledge strong feelings when you hear them.

q: Which is an example of body language/facial expression showing you are listening?
qa: أي مما يلي مثال على لغة الجسد/تعبير الوجه الذي يظهر أنك تستمع؟
o: Nodding your head, smiling, good eye contact
oa: هز الرأس والابتسام وتواصل بصري جيد
e: Show you are listening by giving nonverbal cues – nod your head, smile, make good eye contact.

q: The present perfect continuous is formed with:
qa: يتكون المضارع التام المستمر من:
oa: has / have + been + الفعل مع ing
e: Present perfect continuous is formed using has/have + been + present participle.

q: How are questions formed in the present perfect continuous?
qa: كيف تتكون الأسئلة في المضارع التام المستمر؟
o: By inverting the subject and has/have
e: Questions are indicated by inverting the subject and has/have (Have you been waiting here for two hours?).

q: How are negatives formed in the present perfect continuous?
qa: كيف يتكون النفي في المضارع التام المستمر؟
e: Negatives are made with not (You have not been waiting here for two hours).

q: Use 1 of the present perfect continuous (duration from the past until now): which sentence shows it?
qa: الاستخدام الأول (المدة من الماضي حتى الآن): أي جملة تظهره؟
o: She has been working at that company for three years.
She worked at that company in 2010.
oa: She has been working at that company for three years.
She worked at that company in 2010.
e: We use it to show something started in the past and has continued up until now (for five minutes, for two weeks, since Tuesday).
ea: يدل على حدث بدأ في الماضي واستمر حتى الآن.

q: Use 2 of the present perfect continuous (without a duration) has the general meaning of:
qa: الاستخدام الثاني (بدون مدة) له المعنى العام:
e: Without the duration, the tense has a more general meaning of "lately"; we often use "lately" or "recently".

q: Which sentence is CORRECT?
qa: أي جملة صحيحة؟
o: Sam is having his car since two years.
Sam has been having his car for two years.
Sam has had his car for two years.
Sam had been having his car now.
oa: Sam is having his car since two years.
Sam has been having his car for two years.
Sam has had his car for two years.
Sam had been having his car now.
e: Non-continuous verbs (e.g. have as possession) cannot be used in continuous tenses; use present perfect instead.
ea: الأفعال غير المستمرة تُستخدم مع المضارع التام لا المستمر.

q: Which sentence has the adverb "only" placed correctly in the present perfect continuous?
qa: أي جملة وضع فيها الظرف only بشكل صحيح؟
o: You have been waiting only here one hour for.
You only have been waiting here for one hour.
Only you have waiting been here for one hour.
You have only been waiting here for one hour.
oa: You have been waiting only here one hour for.
You only have been waiting here for one hour.
Only you have waiting been here for one hour.
You have only been waiting here for one hour.
e: Example in the book: "You have only been waiting here for one hour."

q: Asking "Have you been smoking?" in the present perfect continuous can suggest:
qa: سؤال "Have you been smoking?" بالمضارع التام المستمر قد يوحي بأن:
o: You can smell the smoke on the person (see/smell/hear/feel the results)
oa: أنك تشم رائحة الدخان على الشخص (تلاحظ نتائج الفعل)
e: Using this tense in a question suggests you can see, smell, hear or feel the results of the action; it is possible to insult someone by using it incorrectly.

q: The four c's that technology helps learners foster are:
qa: الـ four c's التي تساعد التكنولوجيا المتعلمين على تنميتها هي:
o: Communication, creativity, collaboration and critical thinking
e: Incorporating new technologies allows learners to foster the four c's: communication, creativity, collaboration and critical thinking.

q: Which technology benefit is mentioned for personalized and independent learning?
qa: أي فائدة تكنولوجية مذكورة للتعلم الشخصي والمستقل؟
o: Students can work at their own pace and receive immediate feedback
oa: يعمل الطلاب بسرعتهم ويتلقون تغذية راجعة فورية
e: Students can work at their own pace, complete interactive exercises in class or at home and receive immediate feedback.

q: Which technology helps with reading according to the text?
qa: أي تقنية تساعد في القراءة حسب النص؟
o: iPads, tablets and e-readers like the Kindle
oa: الآيباد والأجهزة اللوحية والقارئات الإلكترونية مثل Kindle
e: With the rise of iPads, tablets and e-readers like the Kindle we get lots of interactive reading experience.

q: Which tool is described as one of the most well-known technological advancements for writing?
qa: أي أداة وُصفت بأنها من أشهر التطورات التقنية للكتابة؟
e: One of the most well-known technological advancements for writing is the word processor.

q: Which technology is designed to let you listen and follow the text as you read?
qa: أي تقنية صُممت لتستمع وتتابع النص أثناء القراءة؟
oa: تقنية Whispersync for Voice من Kindle
e: Kindle's Whispersync for Voice includes audio with selected books so you can listen and follow the text.

q: Which tools give learners the advantage of real-time conversations with English speakers?
qa: أي أدوات تعطي المتعلمين ميزة المحادثة الفورية مع متحدثي الإنجليزية؟
e: Skype and FaceTime are examples that let learners communicate in real-time conversations.

q: Which apps are mentioned for speaking with other learners?
qa: أي تطبيقات مذكورة للتحدث مع متعلمين آخرين؟
e: There are many applications such as CoffeeStrap and HelloTalk.

q: Match the synonym from the article: "Aspect" means:
qa: طابق المرادف من المقال: "Aspect" تعني:
e: Synonym match: Aspect – side.

q: Match the synonym: "Enthusiasm" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Enthusiasm" تعني:
e: Enthusiasm – interest, excitement.

q: Match the synonym: "Embed" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Embed" تعني:
e: Embed – root, fix in.

q: Match the synonym: "Incorporate" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Incorporate" تعني:
e: Incorporate – include, integrate.

q: Match the synonym: "Foster" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Foster" تعني:
e: Foster – enhance.

q: Match the synonym: "Draw on" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Draw on" تعني:
e: Draw on – make use of.

q: Match the synonym: "Beneficial" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Beneficial" تعني:
e: Beneficial – helpful.

q: Match the synonym: "Thesaurus" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Thesaurus" تعني:
e: Thesaurus – dictionary (of synonyms).

q: "Hungry for" (paragraph one) means:
qa: "Hungry for" (الفقرة الأولى) تعني:
e: Most people live their lives through technology. They are hungry for more.

q: "At the touch of a button" means:
qa: "At the touch of a button" تعني:
o: Very easily by pressing a button
e: Downloading whole sets at the touch of a button.

q: "At your fingertips" means:
qa: "At your fingertips" تعني:
oa: متاح لك بسهولة / في متناول يدك
e: These technological advancements are right at your fingertips.

q: "Technology lends itself very well to personalized learning" — "lends itself" means:
qa: "lends itself" في الجملة تعني:
e: lends itself – يصلح لـ / يتناسب مع (book).
ea: lends itself = يصلح لـ / يتناسب مع.

q: "............ is also called an e-book reader. It is any mobile electronic device designed to display text on a screen for reading digital e-books and periodicals."
qa: "............ يسمى أيضاً قارئ الكتب الإلكترونية. وهو جهاز إلكتروني محمول لعرض النصوص على الشاشة لقراءة الكتب الرقمية."
e: e-reader (book definition).

q: "............ is a website on which users modify content and structure collaboratively."
qa: "............ هو موقع يقوم فيه المستخدمون بتعديل المحتوى والبنية بشكل تعاوني."
e: wiki (book definition).

q: "............ is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to."
qa: "............ سلسلة حلقات من ملفات صوتية أو مرئية رقمية يمكن تنزيلها والاستماع إليها."
e: podcast (book definition).

q: "............ is also called a message board. It is an online discussion site where people hold conversations in the form of posted messages."
qa: "............ يسمى أيضاً لوحة الرسائل. وهو موقع نقاش على الإنترنت يتحاور فيه الناس برسائل منشورة."
e: online forum (book definition).

q: "............ is a discussion or informational website consisting of discrete, often informal diary-style text entries (posts)."
qa: "............ موقع نقاشي أو معلوماتي يتكون من إدخالات نصية منفصلة غالباً بأسلوب يوميات (منشورات)."
e: blog (book definition).

q: "............ are language materials designed not for language students, but for the speakers of the language. They provide real-life examples of language used in everyday situations."
qa: "............ مواد لغوية لا تُصمم لطلاب اللغة بل لمتحدثيها، وتوفر أمثلة واقعية للغة في المواقف اليومية."
e: Authentic resources (book definition).

q: The past perfect is formed with:
qa: يتكون الماضي التام من:
e: Form – Affirmative: had + past participle.

q: Which is the negative form in the past perfect?
qa: ما الصيغة المنفية في الماضي التام؟
e: Negative: hadn't / had not / had never + past participle (e.g. I had not eaten at that restaurant before today).

q: How do we form a yes/no question in the past perfect?
qa: كيف نكوّن سؤال نعم/لا في الماضي التام؟
e: Yes/No questions: Had + subject + past participle (Had you cleaned up the mess by the time they came home?).

q: Past perfect is used to talk about:
qa: يُستخدم الماضي التام للحديث عن:
o: Finished actions that happened before a certain time in the past
oa: أحداث منتهية وقعت قبل وقت معين في الماضي
e: Past perfect is used to talk about finished actions that happened before a certain time in the past.
ea: أحداث منتهية قبل وقت معين في الماضي.

q: Which sentence uses the past perfect correctly?
qa: أي جملة تستخدم الماضي التام بشكل صحيح؟
o: I finished had lunch when they arrived.
I have finished lunch when they arrived.
I had finished lunch when they arrived.
I was finish lunch when they arrived.
oa: I finished had lunch when they arrived.
I have finished lunch when they arrived.
I had finished lunch when they arrived.
I was finish lunch when they arrived.
e: Book example: "I had finished lunch when they arrived."

q: Which is a correct wh-question in the past perfect?
qa: أي سؤال بأداة استفهام صحيح في الماضي التام؟
o: Why had he agreed to work for that salary?
Why he had agreed to work for that salary?
oa: Why had he agreed to work for that salary?
Why he had agreed to work for that salary?
e: Wh-word + had + subject + past participle.
ea: أداة الاستفهام + had + الفاعل + التصريف الثالث.

q: Work-life balance refers to:
qa: يشير توازن العمل والحياة إلى:
o: The balance between a person's work and personal life
oa: التوازن بين عمل الشخص وحياته الشخصية
e: Work-life balance refers to the balance between a person's work and his personal life.

q: Why do many people work longer hours, according to the passage?
qa: لماذا يعمل كثير من الناس لساعات أطول حسب القطعة؟
o: In part because of globalization, outsourcing and a loss of job security
oa: جزئياً بسبب العولمة والاستعانة بمصادر خارجية وفقدان الأمان الوظيفي
e: Many people work longer hours and use fewer vacation days, in part because of globalization, outsourcing, and a loss of job security.
ea: العولمة والاستعانة بمصادر خارجية وفقدان الأمان الوظيفي.

q: Which is a result of work-life imbalance?
qa: أي مما يلي نتيجة لاختلال التوازن بين العمل والحياة؟
o: Reduced productivity, depression, high stress and burnout
oa: انخفاض الإنتاجية والاكتئاب وارتفاع التوتر والإنهاك
e: Reduced productivity, depression, high levels of stress, and burnout result from such an imbalance.

q: Which is an example of how employers can promote work-life balance?
qa: أي مما يلي مثال على كيفية تعزيز أصحاب العمل لتوازن العمل والحياة؟
o: Providing flex time, maternity leave, telecommuting or recreation/exercise facilities
oa: توفير ساعات مرنة وإجازة أمومة والعمل عن بعد ومرافق ترفيه/رياضة
e: Employers can promote it, e.g. provide flex time, maternity leave, telecommuting, or recreation or exercise facilities.
ea: ساعات مرنة وإجازة أمومة وعمل عن بعد ومرافق رياضة.

q: What happens when employees feel a greater sense of control and ownership over their lives?
qa: ماذا يحدث عندما يشعر الموظفون بسيطرة وملكية أكبر على حياتهم؟
o: They feel more motivated and less stressed; company productivity increases and conflicts decrease
oa: يصبحون أكثر تحفيزاً وأقل توتراً؛ فتزيد الإنتاجية وتقل الصراعات
e: They tend to feel more motivated and less stressed out at work, which increases productivity and reduces conflicts.

q: Having healthy sleep habits is often referred to as:
qa: يُشار إلى امتلاك عادات نوم صحية غالباً باسم:
e: Having healthy sleep habits is often referred to as having good sleep hygiene.

q: Poor sleep can have negative effects on:
qa: النوم السيئ قد يؤثر سلباً على:
o: Learning, memory, mood, emotions and various biological functions
oa: التعلم والذاكرة والمزاج والانفعالات ووظائف حيوية مختلفة
e: Poor sleep can have negative effects on many parts of your body and brain, including learning, memory, mood, emotions and various biological functions.

q: Why should you lower the room temperature?
qa: لماذا ينبغي خفض درجة حرارة الغرفة؟
o: If your room is too warm, you might have a hard time falling asleep
oa: إذا كانت الغرفة دافئة جداً قد يصعب عليك النوم
e: Your body temperature changes as you fall asleep. If your room is too warm, you might have a hard time falling asleep.

q: Why should you go to bed and wake up at the same times each day?
qa: لماذا يجب النوم والاستيقاظ في نفس الأوقات كل يوم؟
o: It helps your internal clock keep a regular schedule, making it easier to fall asleep and wake up
oa: يساعد ساعتك الداخلية على الانتظام فيسهل النوم والاستيقاظ
e: Get on a schedule: it helps your internal clock keep a regular schedule.

q: Which hormone does darkness boost the production of?
qa: أي هرمون يزيد الظلام من إنتاجه؟
e: Darkness boosts the production of melatonin, an essential hormone for sleep.

q: According to the text, which kind of meal could promote a deeper and more restful sleep?
qa: حسب النص أي وجبات قد تعزز نوماً أعمق وأكثر راحة؟
e: Even though a high-carb diet can get you to fall asleep faster, it will not be restful sleep. Instead, high-fat meals could promote a deeper and more restful sleep.

q: How can exercise help sleep?
qa: كيف تساعد التمارين على النوم؟
o: It can boost serotonin and decrease cortisol, the stress hormone
oa: تزيد السيروتونين وتقلل الكورتيزول هرمون التوتر
e: Exercise can boost the production of serotonin and decrease levels of cortisol, the stress hormone.

q: How long before bedtime should you avoid caffeine?
qa: قبل النوم بكم من الوقت ينبغي تجنب الكافيين؟
e: It is recommended that you refrain from consuming caffeine at least six hours before bedtime.

q: Aromatherapy involves the use of:
qa: العلاج بالروائح يتضمن استخدام:
e: Aromatherapy involves the use of essential oils. It may help with relaxation.

q: According to the passage, the secret to handling mistakes is to:
qa: حسب القطعة سر التعامل مع الأخطاء هو أن:
o: Expect them as part of growth, have an experimental mentality, and think in an evolutionary rather than fixed way
oa: نتوقعها كجزء من النمو ونمتلك عقلية تجريبية ونفكر بطريقة تطورية لا ثابتة
e: Expect mistakes as part of the process of growth and development, have an experimental mentality, and think in an evolutionary rather than fixed way.
ea: نتوقعها كجزء من النمو ونفكر بعقلية تجريبية وتطورية.

q: "Trial and error" is described as:
qa: "المحاولة والخطأ" وُصفت بأنها:
o: A natural way of living; how we have evolved over time
oa: طريقة طبيعية للعيش؛ بها تطورنا عبر الزمن
e: Trial and error is a natural way of living. It is how we have evolved over time.

q: Handling mistakes well can help you:
qa: التعامل الجيد مع الأخطاء قد يساعدك على:
o: Relax and enjoy all aspects of life more
e: Handling mistakes well can help you relax and enjoy all aspects of life more.

q: Which is listed as a benefit of mistakes?
qa: أي مما يلي مذكور كفائدة للأخطاء؟
o: They remind us of our humanity and teach us to value forgiveness
e: List of benefits: Remind us of our humanity; Teach us to value forgiveness; Make us more humble…

q: Match the synonym: "Inevitable" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Inevitable" تعني:
e: Inevitable – cannot be avoided.

q: Match the synonym: "Handle" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Handle" تعني:
e: Handle – deal with.

q: Match the synonym: "Ebb and flow" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Ebb and flow" تعني:
e: Ebb and flow – ups and downs.
ea: Ebb and flow = المد والجزر / صعود وهبوط.

q: Match the synonym: "Ongoing" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Ongoing" تعني:
e: Ongoing – continuous.

q: Match the synonym: "Trial and error" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Trial and error" تعني:
e: Trial and error – examination, experiment (book match).
ea: Trial and error = المحاولة والخطأ / تجربة.

q: Match the synonym: "Pace" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Pace" تعني:
e: Pace – step, walk (book match).

q: Match the synonym: "Humble" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Humble" تعني:
e: Humble – modest.

q: Match the synonym: "Hasten" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Hasten" تعني:
e: Hasten – speed something.

q: Match the synonym: "Evolutionary" means:
qa: طابق المرادف: "Evolutionary" تعني:
e: Evolutionary – changing (book match).

q: Transitional words such as "for example", "for instance", "first", "second" or "last" can help guide the reader.
qa: كلمات الانتقال مثل for example و first و last يمكن أن تساعد في إرشاد القارئ.
e: Step 3: adding transitional or introductory phrases can help guide the reader.
ea: الخطوة 3: عبارات الانتقال تساعد في إرشاد القارئ.

q: Before you submit your writing, you should look over your work at least one more time.
qa: قبل تسليم كتابتك ينبغي مراجعة عملك مرة أخرى على الأقل.
e: Step 5: before you submit your writing, look over your work at least one more time.
ea: الخطوة 5: راجع عملك مرة أخرى على الأقل قبل التسليم.

q: A concluding sentence restates the topic sentence or summarizes your thesis.
qa: الجملة الختامية تعيد صياغة جملة الموضوع أو تلخص الفكرة.
e: Step 4: concluding sentences restate the topic sentence or summarize your thesis.
ea: الخطوة 4: الجملة الختامية تعيد صياغة جملة الموضوع أو تلخص الفكرة.

q: Strong paragraphs are typically about several unrelated ideas.
qa: الفقرات القوية تتناول عادةً عدة أفكار غير مترابطة.
e: Strong paragraphs are typically about one main idea or topic.
ea: الفقرات القوية تدور حول فكرة أو موضوع رئيسي واحد.

q: An apostrophe can be used as a substitute for a missing letter, as in cannot = can't.
qa: يمكن استخدام الأبوستروف بدلاً من حرف ناقص مثل cannot = can't.
e: Apostrophe substitutes for missing letters in a contraction.
ea: الأبوستروف يعوض الحرف الناقص في الاختصار.

q: A question mark is used at the end of a declarative sentence.
qa: تُستخدم علامة الاستفهام في نهاية الجملة الخبرية.
e: A period ends a declarative sentence; a question mark ends a question.
ea: النقطة تنهي الجملة الخبرية وعلامة الاستفهام تنهي السؤال.

q: Exercise: "what are you doing next weekend" needs a capital letter at the beginning and a question mark at the end.
qa: تمرين: الجملة "what are you doing next weekend" تحتاج حرفاً كبيراً في البداية وعلامة استفهام في النهاية.
e: Correct: "What are you doing next weekend?" (a question).
ea: الصحيح: What are you doing next weekend? (سؤال).

q: "Children receive conflicting messages from a variety of sources." is a complete sentence (not a fragment).
qa: "Children receive conflicting messages from a variety of sources." جملة كاملة وليست ناقصة.
e: It has a subject (Children) and a main verb (receive).

q: "Which cannot be silenced: teachers, books, friends, and television programs." is a fragment.
qa: "Which cannot be silenced: teachers, books, friends, and television programs." جملة ناقصة.
e: It begins with the relative pronoun "Which" and is a dependent clause.
ea: تبدأ بالضمير الموصول Which وهي جملة تابعة.

q: "such as books and movies" is a complete sentence.
qa: "such as books and movies" جملة كاملة.
e: It has no subject and no main verb – it is a fragment.
ea: بلا فاعل وبلا فعل رئيسي، فهي ناقصة.

q: "Which is the argument that Charren is making about advertisements directed at children." is a fragment.
qa: "Which is the argument that Charren is making about advertisements directed at children." جملة ناقصة.
e: It begins with the relative pronoun "Which", so it is a dependent clause.
ea: تبدأ بالضمير الموصول Which فهي جملة تابعة.

q: "But as a society having agreed to limit speech only in the most extreme cases." is a fragment.
qa: "But as a society having agreed to limit speech only in the most extreme cases." جملة ناقصة.
e: It has no main verb ("having agreed" is a participle).
ea: ليس لها فعل رئيسي (having agreed مجرد اسم فاعل).

q: "There is nothing in the making of advertisements that is as purposefully vulgar or harmful as there is in child pornography." is a fragment.
qa: "There is nothing in the making of advertisements …" جملة ناقصة.
e: It has a subject (nothing / There) and a main verb (is); it is a complete sentence.
ea: لها فاعل وفعل رئيسي، فهي كاملة.

q: "If anything, advertising more closely resembling the language of our everyday speech." is a fragment.
qa: "If anything, advertising more closely resembling the language of our everyday speech." جملة ناقصة.
e: There is no main verb ("resembling" is a participle).

q: "Oddly enough, ads for pain relievers claim very little, they are undramatic, uninteresting." contains a comma splice.
qa: "Oddly enough, ads for pain relievers claim very little, they are undramatic, uninteresting." بها فاصلة واصلة.
e: Two independent clauses ("ads … claim very little" and "they are undramatic") are joined by a comma.

q: "The advertisements that physicians and surgeons see in their professional journals do attempt to represent acute pain, the difference may be attributable to …" contains a comma splice.
qa: الجملة "The advertisements that physicians … acute pain, the difference may be attributable to …" بها فاصلة واصلة.
e: Two independent clauses are joined by a comma.

q: "Advertisements for aspirin and other pain relievers are incredibly dull they are so like one another …" is a fused sentence (the fusion is after "dull").
qa: الجملة "Advertisements for aspirin … are incredibly dull they are so like one another …" مندمجة (الاندماج بعد dull).
e: Two independent clauses run together with no punctuation: "…are incredibly dull / they are so like…".

q: "They were knowing each other very well" is correct.
qa: "They were knowing each other very well" صحيحة.
e: "Know" is not normally used with the past continuous; the correct form is "They knew each other very well".
ea: know لا تُستخدم عادةً في المستمر؛ الصحيح They knew each other very well.

q: Verbs such as believe, belong, hate, know, like, love, need, prefer and want are not normally used with the past continuous.
qa: أفعال مثل believe, belong, hate, know, like, love, need, prefer, want لا تُستخدم عادةً مع الماضي المستمر.
e: They are not action verbs (Additional points).

q: The past continuous can be used to say that an action in the past was temporary.
qa: يمكن استخدام الماضي المستمر للتعبير عن أن حدثاً في الماضي كان مؤقتاً.
e: Use 4: e.g. "They were living in Paris for a year."
ea: الاستخدام 4 مثل They were living in Paris for a year.

q: The ancient Egyptians worshipped only one god.
qa: عبد المصريون القدماء إلهاً واحداً فقط.
e: They worshipped many gods and goddesses.

q: Ancient Egyptian funerary practices (embalming) led to detailed knowledge of human anatomy.
qa: أدت طقوس الدفن (التحنيط) إلى معرفة تفصيلية بتشريح الإنسان.
e: The text says they "did not lead to detailed knowledge of human anatomy"; nevertheless Egyptian medicine had an excellent reputation.
ea: النص يقول إنها لم تؤدِ إلى معرفة تفصيلية بالتشريح.

q: The civilization of Ancient Egypt was one of the earliest in world history.
qa: حضارة مصر القديمة كانت من أقدم الحضارات في تاريخ العالم.
e: Stated in the first paragraph of the passage.

q: "She has been to the cinema twice this week" shows an action performed during a period that has not yet finished.
qa: "She has been to the cinema twice this week" تدل على حدث في فترة لم تنته بعد.
e: The week isn't over yet.

q: We use the present perfect with a finished time expression such as "yesterday".
qa: نستخدم المضارع التام مع تعبير زمني منتهٍ مثل yesterday.
e: The present perfect is used when the time is not specified; for finished times use the past simple (see Chapter 3 exercises).
ea: المضارع التام لا يُستخدم مع وقت منتهٍ محدد؛ يُستخدم الماضي البسيط.

q: The people of the world are only five times more than China's population.
qa: عدد سكان العالم يزيد بخمسة أضعاف فقط عن سكان الصين.
e: China's population is about one fifth of the earth's entire population, so the world is about five times China's population.
ea: الصين خُمس سكان الأرض، أي العالم نحو خمسة أضعاف.

q: The family planning program was successful in China (in its early stage).
qa: كان برنامج تنظيم الأسرة ناجحاً في الصين (في مرحلته المبكرة).
e: The program had begun already, but there were no major effects.

q: Chinese couples from ethnic minorities are allowed to have more than one child.
qa: يُسمح للأزواج الصينيين من الأقليات العرقية بإنجاب أكثر من طفل.
e: Policy: one child unless one or both of the couple are from an ethnic minority.
ea: طفل واحد إلا إذا كان أحدهما أو كلاهما من أقلية عرقية.

q: Chinese women avoid having obstetric services because there is not good medical care.
qa: تتجنب النساء الصينيات خدمات التوليد لأن الرعاية الطبية غير جيدة.
e: They avoid them because they fear pressure to have an abortion or fines for violating the one-child policy.
ea: يتجنبنها خوفاً من ضغوط الإجهاض أو الغرامات.

q: Chinese women may be forced to have an abortion.
qa: قد تُجبر النساء الصينيات على الإجهاض.
e: Women may face pressure to have an abortion or fines for an unapproved pregnancy.

q: In a good conversation, there is both give and take.
qa: في المحادثة الجيدة يوجد أخذ وعطاء.
e: Stated in the passage.

q: Active listening is not important for the success of a conversation.
qa: الاستماع الفعال ليس مهماً لنجاح المحادثة.
e: Active listening, and making sure you understand the other's response, is essential for the success of any conversation.
ea: الاستماع الفعال أساسي لنجاح أي محادثة.

q: Present perfect continuous is less commonly used in its passive form.
qa: المضارع التام المستمر أقل شيوعاً في صيغة المبني للمجهول.
e: NOTE in the book: present perfect continuous is less commonly used in its passive form.

q: "Recently, the work has been being done by John" is the active form of "Recently, John has been doing the work".
qa: "Recently, the work has been being done by John" هي صيغة المعلوم لـ "Recently, John has been doing the work".
e: It is the passive form; "John has been doing the work" is the active form.
ea: الأولى مبني للمجهول والثانية مبني للمعلوم.

q: "He didn't want to come with us because he had already seen the film" uses the past perfect.
qa: "He didn't want to come with us because he had already seen the film" تستخدم الماضي التام.
e: "had already seen" is past perfect (action before another past time).

q: In "We'd been driving for a long time", "been" is usually reduced to its weak form /bɪn/.
qa: في "We'd been driving for a long time" عادةً يُخفف لفظ been إلى /bɪn/.
e: Pronunciation: been is usually reduced to its weak form in past perfect continuous.

q: People work longer hours because they are worried about their jobs.
qa: يعمل الناس لساعات أطول لأنهم قلقون بشأن وظائفهم.
e: The passage mentions "a loss of job security" as a reason.
ea: الفقدان المحتمل للأمان الوظيفي سبب مذكور.

q: Employees might ignore personal interests if there is a poor work-life balance.
qa: قد يتجاهل الموظفون اهتماماتهم الشخصية إذا ضعف التوازن بين العمل والحياة.
e: Employees have less time for personal interests, personal development and family.

q: Only the company is responsible for overwork.
qa: الشركة وحدها مسؤولة عن الإفراط في العمل.
e: Although the employee makes the choice to work longer hours, companies should educate workers – responsibility is shared.
ea: الموظف يختار العمل لساعات أطول والشركات عليها توعيتهم؛ فالمسؤولية مشتركة.

q: All employees should have flex time and recreation facilities.
qa: يجب أن يحصل جميع الموظفين على ساعات مرنة ومرافق ترفيهية.
e: The passage says employers "can" promote balance with these as examples ("it is helpful to provide"); it does not say all employees must have them.
ea: النص يذكرها كأمثلة مفيدة ولا يقول إنها واجبة لجميع الموظفين.

q: Listening to relaxing music can improve sleep quality and can even help with chronic sleep disorders like insomnia.
qa: الاستماع إلى موسيقى هادئة يحسن جودة النوم وقد يساعد حتى في اضطرابات النوم المزمنة كالأرق.
e: Music can significantly improve quality of sleep and can be used to improve chronic sleep disorders like insomnia.

q: You should keep all electronics, computers and mobile phones on in the bedroom.
qa: ينبغي إبقاء كل الأجهزة الإلكترونية والحواسيب والهواتف تعمل في غرفة النوم.
e: Turn off all electronics: disconnect them to ensure a quiet place free of distractions.
ea: يُنصح بإيقاف الأجهزة للحصول على مكان هادئ.

q: During the day, exposing your body to bright light tells it to stay alert.
qa: تعريض جسمك للضوء الساطع نهاراً يخبره بأن يبقى متيقظاً.
e: During the day, exposing your body to bright light tells it to stay alert.
ea: الضوء الساطع نهاراً يُبقي الجسم متيقظاً.

q: Making mistakes is inevitable.
qa: ارتكاب الأخطاء أمر لا مفر منه.
e: First sentence of the passage: Making mistakes is inevitable.

q: When we recognize the inevitability of mistakes, we can relax more and may make fewer mistakes.
qa: عندما ندرك حتمية الأخطاء نستطيع الاسترخاء أكثر وقد نرتكب أخطاء أقل.
e: When we recognize the inevitability of mistakes … we can relax more. In doing so we may make fewer mistakes.
ea: إدراك حتمية الأخطاء يقلل التوتر وقد يقلل الأخطاء.
